purpose: exploratory, sequence labels are not certified independent physical recordings
standardization: training-fold anchor mean and population standard deviation; zero sd -> 1; unpenalized intercept
main_metric_unit: sequence: mean anchor truth and mean anchor OOF prediction; each sequence equal weight

bootstrap.method: percentile resampling sequence-level fixed OOF errors; not model retraining; paired M1-M2

coefficient_analysis: mean absolute training-fold standardized coefficients, exploratory only; correlated features and fold-specific scaling preclude attribution
history: pre-outcome for this run, inputs already used in prior development
physical_certification: UNKNOWN; must not claim physical independence
